pages.text: An onion structure of side 7: shell -> insulation -> frames -> core.$(br)Plasma fuel rods burn into energy and Life Ash. Efficiency frames multiply yield x1.15^N; cooler frames hold fusion heat sinks.

Fuel chain: Fusion Rod + plasma (from the Plasma Filler) = Plasma Fuel Rod.$(br)Plasma is aggregated from activated components and moved by plasma pipes. Best temperature 100M~130M; 160M overheats (no explosion).
